evidence: In situ spectroscopic ellipsometry was used to measure the SiO2 film thickness and index of refraction versus deposition temperature and reactant exposure. The surface topography of the SiO2 films was measured using a NanoScope III atomic force microscope (AFM). Rutherford backscattering (RBS) experiments were also performed on several SiO2 films to evaluate film stoichiometry. Current voltage measurements were also performed to evaluate the dielectric integrity of the SiO2 films.
